name: Sanctions & coercion
summary: EU sanctioned 113 Russian-linked targets incl. 49 banks on 16 Nov; UK hit Russia's 10 largest oil producers on 12 Nov
state: On 16 Nov the EU Council listed 12 individuals and 101 entities linked to Russia's war economy, including 47 commercial banks, two other credit institutions, 27 oil, gas and mining firms and 15 companies tied to shadow-fleet tankers; a 22nd package is expected before the 26–27 Nov EU summit (Ukrainska Pravda). On 12 Nov the UK sanctioned all 10 of Russia's largest oil producers, including Slavneft and Rosneft's Vostok Oil project (European Pravda). No major economy cut off from payment systems or large seizure of sovereign assets was found as of 18 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Businesses trading with Russia or handling Russian-linked shipments face wider compliance checks; UK firms should follow OFSI guidance on financial sanctions. Effects on consumers tend to show up indirectly through energy and shipping costs.
rubric_hit: Watch: major new EU (16 Nov) and UK (12 Nov) packages on Russia; no payment-system cut-off or sovereign asset seizure (Alert line)
